text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm an amazing Umamusume!
A reporter just asked me about it earlier!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They asked, "You lost last time, but are you confident?" So, you know what I told them?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"She said, 'I'm not a dentist!
I'm an Umamusume who runs and wins races!'"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then everyone gave me a huge round of applause!
I'm so glad I worked hard at both racing and brushing my teeth~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to win!
Let's take 1st place~~!

...At any rate,
Haru Urara was totally fired up.
